hypothesis.statement: Frozen SYSTEM-H-V2-DEV-CANDIDATE (SYSTEM-G candidate generation + EXP-019A projection-aware prior + PERF-003 D1 CE path) meets the engineering qualification gate on NATQ-001 validation n=40, a question-first set SYSTEM-H has never scored.

pipeline.E_L10: within-document additive local BM25, L=10 extras after dedupe excluding A-pool-100
pipeline.projection_aware_retrieval_prior: E-L10 a_norm kept exactly; projection-only retrieval_norm = minmax(projection-RRF) over P extras (degenerate 0.5); combined list not re-minmaxed
pipeline.cross_encoder: frozen ONNX MiniLM CrossEncoderReranker(pad='batch', bucket_by_length=True) PERF-003 D1
pipeline.tie_break: blend DESC, E-L10 merge-RRF rank (projection-only a_rank=10**9), chunk_id ASC

PRIMARY.definition: A case is a success iff EVERY gold evidence span overlaps at least one chunk in the SYSTEM-H top-10 ranked list (version_id + section_path + character overlap, same as EXP-017/019A score_system.fully_recalled).

SECONDARY.definition: A case is a success iff EVERY gold evidence span is present in the SYSTEM-H candidate union (A-pool-100 UNION E-L10 extras UNION P=20 projection extras). Reported as n/40. The @100 name is historical (A pool 100 plus additive extras).
Micro: (gold spans overlapping a top-10 chunk) / (total gold spans in the 40-case set). Also report macro mean of per-case span recall and raw found/total. GATE uses micro >= 0.80.
A case is a success iff EVERY gold version_id appears among version_ids of the top-10 ranked chunks. Reported as n/40. Also report mean per-case doc_recall.
Mean reciprocal rank over gold spans (same as EXP-018 summarise.mrr).
Per-case total wall time; also per-stage if available: SYSTEM-A retrieve, E-L10 local BM25, projection RRF+map, CE, blend.
strict / span / document metrics split by provider openai vs anthropic.
strict and span metrics by major coverage_tags / stress_types present on the validation records.
subset where coverage_tags or stress_types contains exact_identifier_lookup.
subset where len(expected_evidence)>1 or coverage_tags contains multi_span.
subset where coverage_tags or stress_types contains realistic_paraphrase.

ENGINEERING_QUALIFICATION_GATE.label: VALIDATION_SUPPORTED
ENGINEERING_QUALIFICATION_GATE.binomial_ci_95_strict_Recall@10: Clopper-Pearson exact 95% CI; diagnostic only; not a gate

classes: candidate-generation: required evidence absent from candidate pool
ranking: required evidence in pool but outside top 10
document-discovery: required document absent from SYSTEM-A pool / parent documents

STOP.if_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED: DO NOT run holdout. Wait for coordinator to freeze a V2 release candidate and preregister final holdout.
STOP.if_VALIDATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: DO NOT run holdout. Return failures and diagnostics.
